name: coinmarketcap-crypto-ts
display_name: CoinMarketCap Top Crypto & Market Cap Explorer (TypeScript)
description: Fetches top cryptocurrency listings from CoinMarketCap. If an API key is supplied in the environment, it will be used; otherwise, the public endpoint will be used (the API is the same). Currency conversion is configurable, and results can be sorted by market cap (default), price, 24-hour price change, and 24-hour trading volume.

limit.description: The number of results to fetch from CoinMarketCap.

currency.description: The currency used in the results.

rankBy.description: The number of results to fetch from CoinMarketCap.
